I got the phone and I used it for 3 months. the seller gives you 90 days for a refund or replacement. after the second month, the battery started to drain so quickly so if you have a 100% charge it will drop to 0 without using it before the day ends and you didn't even make a phone call. because I don't typically return anything unless it's a big deal. the 3 months passed and I'm in the 4th month I contact the seller, not for a refund or exchange but to fix it. he said you are out of the warranty. My advice is to stay away from any refurbished phone as much as you could and If you cannot then choose the one that has only 100% positive reviews and is keen to listen

It charges faster than I expect, but it should not drain in less than a day with average use. It also gets peculiarly hot, even when I am simply scrolling through simple apps, which attacks the credibility of its "adaptive battery." The last downside is that it came with a cheap charging cable, but that is a minimal fix and nothing unexpected from a used cellphone. I recommend this phone for someone trying to save money on midrange smartphones. Everything about this used phone is the same, except for the unbelievable price they attached to it. Once again, though, its battery may change my mind if anything goes downhill soon.
Battery is very poor. Battery is very poor, drain very fast. I am 100% disappointed. Battery doesn't even last for 3 hours. I would give negative rating if available.

Doesn't hold a charge.. It discharges to 0% after about 10 days even when not in use. I only purchased it in case of emergency when I travel and that is not more that once or twice a month. Otherwise, I never use it. I only use my landline phone. Although maybe once a week I notice that I have received some erroneous call or a text message. I sent the first one back to Amazon for a replacement; however, like the first one, this one will not hold a charge. My flashlight also has a lithium rechargeable battery and, when not in use, even after 2 months, it doesn't discharge, let alone to 0%. Now, in case I go on a trip, and although I don't otherwise use it. I keep it plugged in to the charger.

Battery Life. I have only had the A51 phone a few days and the battery seems to be discharging faster than the A01 that it replaced. Overall, I am pleased with it, especially the size, memory and the fact that I can see the camera function in the bright sunshine.

Samsung Galaxy A51. First at all I want to say this phone DOES WORK with Boost Mobile, I just had to buy the Sim Card and It works perfectly. The phone it's a little smaller than I expected but I'm getting use to it. What I don't like about this phone is that the description says long battery life and in my opinion that is not true, I don't use the phone that often, for example streaming videos or TV shows, and I have to charge the phone every day ... Every day battery drains till 50% or 40% and that is a lot for me specially because I don't use the phone that often as I already said.

So far, not bad.. I just received this phone so I will give an update in time. So far its not bad. I had a A51 before but dropped it in water (for like second!) and the screen went black. So I got another one because I really like the camera feature. The only thing I have noticed so far is that the battery does not last long like my first one. My first A51 which was brand new, could go 24hrs and a little bit longer, no problem. This one starts to drain at the end of the day. So other than that, it's still a good one, so far- for it being refurbished. Just don't drop it in water! Oh, and I use Straight Talk but planning on switching to Pure Talk in the future. It works fine with Straight Talk.

Horrible Battery Life and Poor Communication. I received my phone and loved it. I updated the phone and the very next day, I found it couldn't hold a charge. I am extremely disappointed. On top of all that, I was told to send my phone back for a replacement and I would receive an updated tracking number of the new one they would send me. Instead, after 14 days, I had to reach out to the company to check my status of the replacement, and was told I was refunded and I would not be getting a replacement. After much confusion, I need to contact my bank to make sure I received a refund, which is not showing up on my end. I am not happy with my overall experience with this company.
